posts.name: Chandra
posts.cooked:
image583×198 30.5 KB

BPT problem file in /opt/se2001.

Now, when I run solution in bash i.e /opt/se2001/BPT_problem_1, i get error as

touch: cannot touch ‘/home/21f1004550/se2001/BPT1_problem_1/Dept1/TeamA/project1’: No such file or directory

I understand that directories are in ~/se2001 but when I am going to this location, there is no file named BPT1_problem_1… (refer image)

what i am doing wrong? Pls guide.

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
All you need to do is

cd ~/se2001
mkdir BPT1_problem_1
cd BPT1_problem_1
synchro init

You have to create the assignment directory under ~/se2001 with the same name as shown under /opt/se2001. Because your BPT1 is named BPT1_problem_1, you have to create a directory named BPT1_problem_1 under ~/se2001 and then run synchro init from inside it.

posts.name: Trisha Bhadra
posts.cooked:
I got repeat-OPPE on System Commands and repeating the same in this term. To get the eligibility and also for practice when we are trying to open the virtual machine login and see the questions, no question is showing and only the bpt problem submitted in the previous term are present.

When I am giving the command cd opt nothing is showing, when typed the command synchro show it showed

no such file in this directiry

What should I do? No BPT or NPPE question is available. Please help me out.

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
You seem to be doing things wrong. For starters check the README.md file in your home directory and read the instructions given there.

trisha.b:

When I am giving the command ‘cd opt’ nothing is showing, when typed the command ‘synchro show’ it showed no such file in this directiry

Your BPT problems are available inside /opt/se2001. There is not directory named opt, the leading forward slash matters.

Do ls -ld /opt/se2001/BPT* to check if BPT directories are present inside /opt/se2001/. Ideally they should be visible for everyone but they aren’t let us know.

If they are present then create a directory under ~/se2001 with the same name as the BPT problem you’re attempting (eg. BPT1_problem_1), then go inside that directory and do synchro show. You should be able to view your problems.
